access_offers_price_currency_check.name: access_offers_price_currency_check
access_offers_price_currency_check.value: "access_offers"."price_minor" IS NULL OR "access_offers"."currency" IS NOT NULL

catalog_program_summaries_counts_check.name: catalog_program_summaries_counts_check
catalog_program_summaries_counts_check.value: "catalog_program_summaries"."nominal_hours" >= 0 AND "catalog_program_summaries"."course_count" >= 0 AND "catalog_program_summaries"."available_course_count" >= "catalog_program_summaries"."course_count" AND "catalog_program_summaries"."learning_unit_count" >= 0 AND "catalog_program_summaries"."assessment_count" >= 0 AND "catalog_program_summaries"."resource_count" >= 0 AND "catalog_program_summaries"."concentration_count" >= 0

competency_mappings_one_target_check.name: competency_mappings_one_target_check
competency_mappings_one_target_check.value:
(
        CASE WHEN "competency_mappings"."program_version_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN "competency_mappings"."course_version_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN "competency_mappings"."content_unit_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ) = 1

content_units_due_after_release_check.name: content_units_due_after_release_check
content_units_due_after_release_check.value: "content_units"."due_offset_days" IS NULL OR "content_units"."release_offset_days" IS NULL OR "content_units"."due_offset_days" >= "content_units"."release_offset_days"

learner_assessment_attempts_score_check.name: learner_assessment_attempts_score_check
learner_assessment_attempts_score_check.value:
("learner_assessment_attempts"."score" IS NULL AND "learner_assessment_attempts"."maximum_score" IS NULL)
        OR ("learner_assessment_attempts"."score" IS NOT NULL AND "learner_assessment_attempts"."maximum_score" IS NOT NULL AND "learner_assessment_attempts"."score" >= 0 AND "learner_assessment_attempts"."maximum_score" > 0 AND "learner_assessment_attempts"."score" <= "learner_assessment_attempts"."maximum_score")

learner_assessment_attempts_lifecycle_ch.name: learner_assessment_attempts_lifecycle_check
learner_assessment_attempts_lifecycle_ch.value:
("learner_assessment_attempts"."status" = 'draft' AND "learner_assessment_attempts"."submitted_at" IS NULL AND "learner_assessment_attempts"."evaluated_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("learner_assessment_attempts"."status" = 'submitted' AND "learner_assessment_attempts"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "learner_assessment_attempts"."evaluated_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("learner_assessment_attempts"."status" = 'evaluated' AND "learner_assessment_attempts"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "learner_assessment_attempts"."evaluated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "learner_assessment_attempts"."passed" IS NOT NULL AND "learner_assessment_attempts"."evaluation_method" IS NOT NULL)
        OR "learner_assessment_attempts"."status" = 'void'

learner_schedule_entries_start_time_chec.name: learner_schedule_entries_start_time_check
learner_schedule_entries_start_time_chec.value: "learner_schedule_entries"."start_time" IS NULL OR (length("learner_schedule_entries"."start_time") = 5 AND "learner_schedule_entries"."start_time" GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' AND substr("learner_schedule_entries"."start_time", 1, 2) <= '23')

learner_schedule_entries_completion_chec.name: learner_schedule_entries_completion_check
learner_schedule_entries_completion_chec.value:
("learner_schedule_entries"."status" = 'completed' AND "learner_schedule_entries"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("learner_schedule_entries"."status" <> 'completed' AND "learner_schedule_entries"."completed_at" IS NULL)

learner_term_schedule_rows_break_check.name: learner_term_schedule_rows_break_check
learner_term_schedule_rows_break_check.value: ("learner_term_schedule_rows"."break_start_date" IS NULL AND "learner_term_schedule_rows"."break_end_date" IS NULL) OR ("learner_term_schedule_rows"."break_start_date" IS NOT NULL AND "learner_term_schedule_rows"."break_end_date" IS NOT NULL AND date("learner_term_schedule_rows"."break_start_date") = "learner_term_schedule_rows"."break_start_date" AND date("learner_term_schedule_rows"."break_end_date") = "learner_term_schedule_rows"."break_end_date" AND "learner_term_schedule_rows"."break_end_date" >= "learner_term_schedule_rows"."break_start_date")

learner_today_assignment_rows_subject_ch.name: learner_today_assignment_rows_subject_check
learner_today_assignment_rows_subject_ch.value: ("learner_today_assignment_rows"."subject_kind" = 'learning_unit' AND "learner_today_assignment_rows"."learning_unit_id" = "learner_today_assignment_rows"."subject_id" AND "learner_today_assignment_rows"."assessment_version_id" IS NULL) OR ("learner_today_assignment_rows"."subject_kind" = 'assessment_version' AND "learner_today_assignment_rows"."assessment_version_id" = "learner_today_assignment_rows"."subject_id")

learner_today_assignment_rows_start_time.name: learner_today_assignment_rows_start_time_check
learner_today_assignment_rows_start_time.value: "learner_today_assignment_rows"."start_time" IS NULL OR (length("learner_today_assignment_rows"."start_time") = 5 AND "learner_today_assignment_rows"."start_time" GLOB '[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]' AND substr("learner_today_assignment_rows"."start_time", 1, 2) <= '23')

learner_today_assignment_rows_completion.name: learner_today_assignment_rows_completion_check
learner_today_assignment_rows_completion.value: ("learner_today_assignment_rows"."status" = 'completed' AND "learner_today_assignment_rows"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("learner_today_assignment_rows"."status" <> 'completed' AND "learner_today_assignment_rows"."completed_at" IS NULL)

learner_transcript_rows_values_check.name: learner_transcript_rows_values_check
learner_transcript_rows_values_check.value: "learner_transcript_rows"."position" >= 0 AND "learner_transcript_rows"."nominal_hours" >= 0 AND "learner_transcript_rows"."total_units" >= 0 AND "learner_transcript_rows"."completed_units" >= 0 AND "learner_transcript_rows"."completed_units" <= "learner_transcript_rows"."total_units" AND "learner_transcript_rows"."completed_learning_hours" >= 0 AND "learner_transcript_rows"."assessment_hours" >= 0 AND "learner_transcript_rows"."assessment_count" >= 0 AND "learner_transcript_rows"."assessment_attempt_count" >= 0 AND "learner_transcript_rows"."project_count" >= 0 AND "learner_transcript_rows"."evidenced_project_count" >= 0 AND "learner_transcript_rows"."evidenced_project_count" <= "learner_transcript_rows"."project_count" AND "learner_transcript_rows"."evidence_count" >= 0 AND "learner_transcript_rows"."source_progress_revision" >= 0

learner_unit_evidence_status_payload_che.name: learner_unit_evidence_status_payload_check
learner_unit_evidence_status_payload_che.value:
("learner_unit_evidence"."status" = 'active' AND length(trim("learner_unit_evidence"."text_or_url")) > 0 AND "learner_unit_evidence"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "learner_unit_evidence"."tombstoned_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("learner_unit_evidence"."status" = 'tombstoned' AND "learner_unit_evidence"."text_or_url" IS NULL AND "learner_unit_evidence"."submitted_at" IS NULL AND "learner_unit_evidence"."tombstoned_at" IS NOT NULL)

learner_unit_states_status_timestamps_ch.name: learner_unit_states_status_timestamps_check
learner_unit_states_status_timestamps_ch.value:
("learner_unit_states"."status" = 'completed' AND "learner_unit_states"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "learner_unit_states"."tombstoned_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("learner_unit_states"."status" = 'tombstoned' AND "learner_unit_states"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "learner_unit_states"."tombstoned_at" IS NOT NULL)

slug_aliases_one_target_check.name: slug_aliases_one_target_check
slug_aliases_one_target_check.value:
(
        CASE WHEN "slug_aliases"."program_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN "slug_aliases"."course_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN "slug_aliases"."competency_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN "slug_aliases"."provider_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN "slug_aliases"."resource_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ) = 1

slug_aliases_namespace_target_check.name: slug_aliases_namespace_target_check
slug_aliases_namespace_target_check.value:
("slug_aliases"."namespace" = 'program' AND "slug_aliases"."program_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("slug_aliases"."namespace" = 'course' AND "slug_aliases"."course_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("slug_aliases"."namespace" = 'competency' AND "slug_aliases"."competency_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("slug_aliases"."namespace" = 'provider' AND "slug_aliases"."provider_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("slug_aliases"."namespace" = 'resource' AND "slug_aliases"."resource_id" IS NOT NULL)
